models.modelDescription: 该模型是基于Qwen3.5-27B的推理蒸馏版本，针对Claude Code等现代编程代理进行了环境适配。它修复了Jinja模板对“developer”角色支持不足导致的崩溃问题，默认开启思维链模式，支持长达9分钟的连续推理，显著提升了作为编程助手时的自主性与执行稳定性，适合需要长时间深度思考的复杂开发场景。
models.sourceDescription: Build Environment Upgrades: - Fine-tuning Framework : Unsloth 2026.3.3 - Core Dependencies : Transformers 5.2.0 - This model fixes the crash in the official model caused by the Jinja template not supporting the "developer" role. (commonly sent by modern coding agents like Claude Code and OpenCode) - It does not disable thinking mode by default , and allowing the agent to run continuously for over 9 minutes without interruption . - Compared to the original model, autonomy and stability are significantly improved .

models.sourceDescription: Cohere Transcribe is an open source release of a 2B parameter dedicated audio-in, text-out automatic speech recognition (ASR) model. The model supports 14 languages.

models.modelDescription: Voxtral-4B-TTS-2603 是一款前沿的开源文本转语音模型，参数规模为 40 亿。该模型强调响应速度与即时适配能力，能够生成高保真的类人语音，非常适合在语音交互智能体中应用。发布版本包含 BF16 权重及一组参考音色，遵循 CC BY-NC 4 协议。
models.sourceDescription: Voxtral TTS is a frontier, open-weights text-to-speech model that’s fast, instantly adaptable, and produces lifelike speech for voice agents. The model is released with BF16 weights and a set of reference voices. These voices are licensed under CC BY-NC 4, which is the license that the model inherits.

models.modelDescription: baidu/Qianfan-OCR 是一款专注于文档智能的端到端统一模型，参数规模为 50 亿。该模型旨在通过统一的架构处理图像文本提取与识别任务，具备极强的文档分析能力，适用于企业级文档数字化、复杂表格解析及自动化信息录入等各类办公场景，助力提升文档处理效率。
models.sourceDescription: A Unified End-to-End Model for Document Intelligence

models.modelDescription: Context-1 是一款 200 亿参数的智能搜索模型，专门用于处理复杂的多跳查询并检索支持性文档。它作为前沿推理模型的检索子代理，能够将查询分解为子问题，通过迭代搜索文档库并动态编辑上下文以释放模型容量，从而显著提升复杂问答任务的准确性与信息获取深度。
models.sourceDescription: Context-1 is a 20B parameter agentic search model trained to retrieve supporting documents for complex, multi-hop queries. It is designed to be used as a retrieval subagent alongside a frontier reasoning model: given a query, Context-1 decomposes it into subqueries, iteratively searches a corpus, and selectively edits its own context to free capacity for further exploration.

models.modelDescription: GAIR/daVinci-MagiHuman 是一个采用单流架构设计的快速音视频生成基础模型。通过简化架构，该模型旨在实现高效的视频生成流程，在保持视觉质量的同时提升生成速度，适用于需要快速生成人类视频素材或进行相关音视频交互的创意与研究领域。
models.sourceDescription: Speed by Simplicity: A Single-Stream Architecture for Fast Audio-Video Generative Foundation Model

models.modelDescription: 这款基于 Qwen3.5-35B 的模型是一个去除了审查限制的版本，在保留原版模型全部能力与数据集的基础上，完全取消了对用户提问的拒绝机制。该模型旨在提供不受约束的输出，适用于需要更自由表达、不受安全对齐限制干扰的特定研究或实验性开发场景。
models.sourceDescription: No changes to datasets or capabilities. Fully functional, 100% of what the original authors intended - just without the refusals.

models.modelDescription: 这是 Qwen3.5-27B 推理蒸馏模型的 GGUF 二代版本。相比初版，它在 HumanEval 上保持了 96.91% 的高准确率，同时将思维链长度缩短了 24%，每 Token 产生正确答案的效率提升了 31.6%。但需注意，该版本在 MMLU-Pro 等通用知识推理测试中表现有所下降，更适合对编程逻辑效率有高要求的场景。
models.sourceDescription: v2 Update: - Accuracy preserved: Matches base model on HumanEval ( 96.91% pass@1 ) - Shorter reasoning: 24% reduction in chain-of-thought length - Higher efficiency: +31.6% more correct solutions per token - ⚠️ Trade-off: −1.24% on HumanEval+ −7.2% on MMLU-Pro (Indicating reduced general knowledge reasoning performance) ⚠️Note: Due to the scope of SFT data and training focus, the model may underperform the base model on certain tasks requiring long-context understanding or more complex multi-step reasoning. The efficiency and accuracy results reported here are based solely on the HumanEval and HumanEval+ benchmarks. Thank you for your understanding.

models.modelDescription: HauhauCS/Qwen3.5-9B-Uncensored是Qwen3.5-9B模型的去审查版本。该模型完整保留了原版的性能与功能，去除了内置的安全拒绝机制，旨在为用户提供不受限制的指令响应体验，适用于需要高自由度对话的学术研究或特定应用开发场景。
models.sourceDescription: No changes to datasets or capabilities. Fully functional, 100% of what the original authors intended - just without the refusals.

models.modelDescription: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B是由阿里巴巴开发的图像-文本多模态大模型。该模型具备强大的视觉理解与语言生成能力，能够高效处理图片与文本的混合输入，适用于图像描述、视觉问答及各类通用型多模态人工智能交互场景。
Lightricks/LTX-2.3是一款专注于图像转视频生成的基础模型，系LTX-2的升级版本。该版本显著提升了音视频生成质量与对提示词的遵循能力，旨在为视频创作领域提供更高效、更具表现力的自动化视觉内容生成解决方案。
models.sourceDescription: This model card focuses on the LTX-2.3 model, which is a significant update to the LTX-2 model with improved audio and visual quality as well as enhanced prompt adherence. LTX-2 was presented in the paper LTX-2: Efficient Joint Audio-Visual Foundation Model.

models.modelDescription: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Next是一款74B参数的Any-to-Any多模态大模型。该模型具备跨媒介处理能力，支持多类型数据间的任意转换，旨在应对复杂的多模态输入输出需求，适用于需要高度通用性与跨域处理能力的各类高级智能任务。
该模型是基于Qwen3.5-9B开发的推理蒸馏模型，通过对Claude Opus的推理逻辑进行知识蒸馏训练。其在保持9B参数量轻量级优势的同时，旨在提升复杂任务的逻辑推理表现，适用于对计算资源受限但有逻辑处理需求的场景。注意由于训练集样本规模约束，通用性可能有所削弱。

models.sourceDescription: Description gpt-oss-puzzle-88B is a deployment-optimized large language model developed by NVIDIA, derived from OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b. The model is produced using Puzzle, a post-training neural architecture search (NAS) framework, with the goal of significantly improving inference efficiency for reasoning-heavy workloads while maintaining or improving accuracy across reasoning budgets.

models.modelDescription: Qwen3.5-27B 是通义千问系列的大语言模型，具备多模态处理能力。作为一款中等参数规模的模型，它在语言理解、逻辑推理及跨模态任务中表现均衡，适合部署于企业级知识库、智能助手及各类需要复杂内容生成与分析的AI应用程序。
SAM 3.1 是 Meta 推出的视频与图像分割基座模型，基于概念提示实现对象识别、分割及跟踪。该模型引入了对象多路复用技术，大幅提升了多目标跟踪的推理速度，支持通过文本或视觉提示进行开放词汇表的对象分割，适用于复杂的视频分析任务。
models.sourceDescription: SAM 3.1 SAM 3 (Segment Anything with Concepts) is a unified foundation model from Meta for promptable segmentation in images and videos. It detects, segments, and tracks objects using text or visual prompts such as points, boxes, and masks. SAM 3 introduces the ability to exhaustively segment all instances of an open-vocabulary concept specified by a short text phrase, handling over 50x more unique concepts than existing benchmarks. SAM 3.1 builds on this with Object Multiplex , a shared-memory approach for joint multi-object tracking that delivers 7x faster inference at 128 objects on a single H100 GPU without sacrificing accuracy, along with improved VOS performance on 6 out of 7 benchmarks.

models.modelDescription: FHDR_Uncensored 是一款基于 Diffusers 框架训练的文生图模型。开发者采用了随机选择层和块的训练策略，在缩短训练时间的同时试图优化生成效果。该模型被标记为无审查版本，主要用于图像生成任务，适用于需要探索不同风格图像生成的特定用户群体。
models.sourceDescription: I trained this model using the Diffusers library by randomly selecting layers and blocks (not training every layer), which reduced the training time and is expected to yield better results.

models.modelDescription: harrier-oss-v1-0.6b 是微软发布的轻量级多语言文本嵌入模型，采用仅解码器架构。该模型通过最后令牌池化与L2归一化生成稠密向量，在信息检索、语义相似度、聚类与分类等任务中表现优异，尤其适用于多语言环境下的高效向量化表示需求。
models.sourceDescription: harrier-oss-v1 is a family of multilingual text embedding models developed by Microsoft. The models use decoder-only architectures with last-token pooling and L2 normalization to produce dense text embeddings. They can be applied to a wide range of tasks, including but not limited to retrieval , clustering , semantic similarity , classification , bitext mining , and reranking . The models achieve state-of-the-art results on the Multilingual MTEB v2 benchmark as of the release date.

models.modelDescription: Jackrong/Qwen3.5-9B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled-GGUF 是一款基于 Qwen3.5 架构的推理增强模型。它通过蒸馏高质量推理数据（包括科学、数学及指令遵循领域），强化了模型在复杂任务中的结构化分步推理能力。该模型以 GGUF 格式发布，适合对逻辑推演和多样化分析有较高需求的开发者在本地进行部署与应用。
models.sourceDescription: Update: This model has been further enhanced with additional reasoning data distilled from Qwen3.5-27B . The new training data introduces higher-quality reasoning trajectories across domains such as science, instruction-following, and mathematics . Part of the data comes from Jackrong/Qwen3.5-reasoning-700x , a curated dataset designed to improve structured step-by-step reasoning and reasoning diversity .

models.modelDescription: fishaudio/s2-pro 是一款 5B 参数的语音合成模型，专注于提供精细化的音频生成控制。该模型支持多说话人与多轮对话场景，具备低延迟流式处理能力，并支持长上下文推理。其定位在于高质量、实时的语音交互应用，能够满足用户对自然感、连贯性和跨场景语音输出的需求。
RuneXX/LTX-2.3-Workflows 是一套专注于图像转视频（Image-to-Video）的生成工作流集合。该项目旨在利用 LTX-2.3 模型能力，通过优化的处理流程，实现高质量的动态视频内容生成。该工作流适用于内容创作者与视觉艺术工作者，助力用户便捷地将静态图片转化为具备连贯动作的视频内容。

models.modelDescription: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 是 Qwen 系列模型的新成员，采用 36B 参数规模，支持图像与文本的综合处理。作为一款强大多模态基座模型，它在视觉理解与文本生成任务中表现出色，能够处理复杂的跨模态交互需求。该模型适用于各类人工智能应用开发，尤其适合对图像分析、视觉问答及大规模自然语言处理有高要求的场景。
